_comment: The identity an overlay may NOT move. `build_overlay.py` refuses a source
that changes any pinned field, because changing one of these is a different
plugin wearing this one's release slot, not an update to it.
A null means NOT PINNED — we do not know the value, and a guess written
here would be a check that passes for the wrong reason. Fill a null in from
the plugin you actually own before relying on it.
`version` is the floor: an overlay must advance on it. It is set to 0.0.0
because the current released version has not been read back from the
Creator here; set it to the release you are updating FROM before the first
real build, or an overlay that repeats the live version would be accepted.
The plugin id is an IDENTIFIER the operator supplied for this offline
contract. It is not a credential, and nothing here creates, updates,
rolls back or uninstalls a plugin.
